title: Leader answer — common envelope (stage 3, scope §2.0, §2.4, §2.7, §2.9)
description: The stage-2 envelope + defer + session: blocked, output-format-twice, session-limit, on-fail-exceeded, soft-budget, and step-add-limit (where both fields are dropped: {requirement_rows}, {models} and {efforts} are filled with []) + close (K8-3: blocked before any developer step — elsewhere {close_reasons} is [] and the field is dropped). ENUM TEMPLATE: values like "{answers}" are placeholders that schema.fill_enums replaces for each call (codes.LEADER_SCHEMA_TOKENS); an enum that comes out empty drops the nearest array or nullable property (read as [] / null). Keeps to type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum (the CLI's structured-output subset). Rules a schema cannot say are checked by gxengine/leader.py (codes.LeaderFormatReason).

answer.description: One of the answers the engine allows for this call (rendered per call). The engine acts on this field only.

reason.description: Leader-decision reason code (§4.2, scope D20). Pick `other` only when no code fits.

step.description: The step to run again — set exactly when answer is rerun, otherwise null.

note.description: Free text for the next role (leader-decision.md), the human and evolve. The engine never branches on it.

recommendation.description: Set exactly when answer is escalate: what you recommend the human answers (scope D15). Otherwise null.

step.description: Set exactly when the recommended answer is rerun.

defer.description: E30: requirement rows to leave out of this Issue. Only with answer replan (else null); never every row, never one twice, once per Issue.

session.description: §7.9 layer 5 (E28): model and effort of the rerun step. Only with answer rerun (else null); `reason` must then be high-complexity, repeated-failure or other. null = keep them.

reason.description: completed = already achieved; not-planned = decided not to do it.

close.description: K8-3: set exactly when answer is close-as-decided. Otherwise null.
